dialogue.origin: こんばんは。よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for meeting with me.

dialogue.origin: こんばんわ
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Likewise.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどんなご相談でしたでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 妻のことで悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm having some trouble with my wife.

dialogue.origin: はい、奥様のことですね。どのようなことか具体的に教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: I see, it’s about your wife. Could you tell me more specifically what’s going on?

dialogue.origin: 機嫌が悪いんです
dialogue.content: She’s in a bad mood.

dialogue.origin: 自分に八つ当たりするんです
dialogue.content: She takes it out on me.

dialogue.origin: はい、それはお困りですよね
dialogue.content: I understand, that must be difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: 疲れます
dialogue.content: It’s exhausting.

dialogue.origin: どんな時にとかございますか？
dialogue.content: Does this happen at any specific times?

dialogue.origin: よくわからないんですけど、日によって良かったり悪かったりです
dialogue.content: I'm not really sure. It varies from day to day; some days are good and others are bad.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、それじゃあ疲れてしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very tiring.

dialogue.origin: ずっと機嫌悪いなぁと思ったら急に元通りになったり
dialogue.content: Just when I think she's going to be in a bad mood for a while, she suddenly goes back to normal.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: また機嫌悪くなったりの繰り返しです
dialogue.content: Then it happens all over again—it’s a cycle.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、心配にもなりますよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be worrying for you.

dialogue.origin: そうですね…
dialogue.content: Yes, it is...

dialogue.origin: いつぐらいからそのような感じなのですか？
dialogue.content: About how long has it been like this?

dialogue.origin: 子どもが生まれてから特にひどいですね
dialogue.content: It's gotten especially bad since our child was born.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、失礼ですが、、
dialogue.content: I see. If I may ask…

dialogue.origin: お子様は今何歳くらいですか？
dialogue.content: How old is your child now?

dialogue.origin: いま、3歳です
dialogue.content: They’re three years old.

dialogue.origin: はい、有難うございます。
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうしますと、３年間は特にひどく、、その前からもそういうことがあったんですね。
dialogue.content: So it's been particularly bad for the last three years, but it was happening before that as well.

dialogue.origin: 長い間、ご不安だったんですね
dialogue.content: You must have been worried for a long time.

dialogue.origin: その前は機嫌悪くても八つ当たりとかなかったんですよね…
dialogue.content: Before that, even if she was in a bad mood, she didn’t take it out on me.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 子どもは手のかからない子なので
dialogue.content: Our child isn't difficult to care for.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうれは素晴らしいですね
dialogue.content: I see, that’s wonderful.

dialogue.origin: 育児が大変という感じではないと思っているんですけど…
dialogue.content: So I don't think it's because raising our child is particularly hard for her...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 何か思いあたることとかございますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything you can think of that might be causing this?

dialogue.origin: 特には…
dialogue.content: Not in particular…

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 私もいろいろと育児は手伝っています
dialogue.content: I help a lot with childcare, too.

dialogue.origin: それは素晴らしいことですね
dialogue.content: That's a wonderful thing to do.

dialogue.origin: お二人で協力して育児されてるんですね
dialogue.content: So you're both working together to raise your child.

dialogue.origin: 機嫌悪くなるときは特に妻を気遣って…食事、子どもの面倒とかやってます
dialogue.content: When she gets into a bad mood, I'm especially considerate of her... I'll handle meals, take care of the child, and so on.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、気遣いで疲れちゃうわけですね
dialogue.content: I see, so being so considerate is tiring for you.

dialogue.origin: それもあります
dialogue.content: That’s part of it.

dialogue.origin: 他にはございますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else?

dialogue.origin: とにかく妻のご機嫌を損ねないようにはしています
dialogue.content: I just try not to upset her in any way.

dialogue.origin: 他にはというのは？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by 'anything else'?

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: それもありますってことでしたので、、
dialogue.content: You mentioned that’s part of it, so…

dialogue.origin: 奥様はどんな時機嫌悪くなるんですか？
dialogue.content: When does your wife tend to get into a bad mood?

dialogue.origin: 気遣い以外でとても疲れますということでした
dialogue.content: I meant that, besides the constant consideration, it’s very draining.

dialogue.origin: はい、わかりました。失礼しました
dialogue.content: I understand. My apologies.

dialogue.origin: 仕事から戻ると機嫌が悪かったり
dialogue.content: Sometimes she’s in a bad mood when I get home from work.

dialogue.origin: 朝起きたら機嫌が悪かったりです
dialogue.content: Or she wakes up in a bad mood in the morning.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 子どもにも当たったりしています
dialogue.content: She sometimes takes it out on our child, too.

dialogue.origin: それは困っちゃいますね
dialogue.content: That must be distressing.

dialogue.origin: 本当に困ります
dialogue.content: It really is.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、長い間お困りだったと思います
dialogue.content: Yes, it sounds like you’ve been struggling with this for a long time.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 機嫌悪くなる理由とか、心当たりとかございますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any idea what might be causing her bad moods?

dialogue.origin: よくわからないんですよね
dialogue.content: I’m not really sure.

dialogue.origin: しょっちゅうというわけではないんですが、
dialogue.content: It's not like it's all the time, but...

dialogue.origin: はい、どれくらいの感覚ですか？月１回とか
dialogue.content: Yes, about how often? Once a month?

dialogue.origin: 2、3週間に一度は必ず機嫌悪くなるんですよ
dialogue.content: She'll definitely get into a bad mood once every two or three weeks.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、お疲れになりますね
dialogue.content: I see... that must be draining.

dialogue.origin: 機嫌悪いだけならいいんですけどね
dialogue.content: If it were just a bad mood, it would be one thing…

dialogue.origin: はい？他には？
dialogue.content: Oh? Is there more?

dialogue.origin: こちらに当たり散らすとか文句はすごいというか
dialogue.content: She lashes out at me and complains a lot—it’s intense.

dialogue.origin: 子どもにも怒鳴っているというか…
dialogue.content: And she yells at our child, too…

dialogue.origin: そうですか・・・
dialogue.content: I understand…

dialogue.origin: なんとかなりませんかね？
dialogue.content: Isn't there something that can be done?

dialogue.origin: 妻も無意識なのかよくわからなくて…
dialogue.content: I'm not sure if my wife is even aware she's doing it...

dialogue.origin: どんな時にそうなるのか、問題の根本が気になりますよね
dialogue.content: You’re wondering what triggers it and what the underlying issue is.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, it does.

dialogue.origin: 原因とかがあるならいいんですけどけ
dialogue.content: I wish there were a clear cause.

dialogue.origin: ３年以上も続いてるわけですから、相当お疲れですよね
dialogue.content: Since this has been going on for more than three years, you must be really exhausted.

dialogue.origin: そうですね…
dialogue.content: Yes, I am...

dialogue.origin: 奥様とはこの事で何か話し合われたりとかされましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you tried discussing this with your wife?

dialogue.origin: 一度機嫌が悪くなると1週間くらいずっとイライラしていて…
dialogue.content: Once she gets into a bad mood, she stays irritable for about a week…

dialogue.origin: そんなにですか！
dialogue.content: For that long?!

dialogue.origin: 機嫌がいいときには何か嫌なことあった？とか聞いたりはします
dialogue.content: When she's in a good mood, I'll ask her things like, "Did something unpleasant happen?"

dialogue.origin: 特にないようですね…
dialogue.content: She says there's nothing in particular...

dialogue.origin: 家に戻るのが嫌になるというか…
dialogue.content: It kind of makes me dread coming home...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: どう思いますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 大変ご苦労されてますね
dialogue.content: You’ve been going through a lot.

dialogue.origin: そうですね…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 他に、きになることとかございますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else that's on your mind?

dialogue.origin: 気になるというか、なんで機嫌悪いの？って感じです
dialogue.content: It's less that something is on my mind and more just, "Why is she in such a bad mood?"

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、そう感じますよね
dialogue.content: Right, I can see why you'd feel that way.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 例えば最近機嫌悪くなった時の事を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: For example, could you tell me about a recent time when she was in a bad mood?

dialogue.origin: 最近というかいつもだいたい同じですよ
dialogue.content: It’s not just recently—it’s usually the same pattern.

dialogue.origin: まずはむすっとしている
dialogue.content: First, she gets sullen.

dialogue.origin: 話しかけても無視される
dialogue.content: Even if I talk to her, she ignores me.

dialogue.origin: 急に怒りだす
dialogue.content: Then she suddenly gets angry.

dialogue.origin: あとは罵声をあびせられる
dialogue.content: After that, she hurls insults at me.

dialogue.origin: 子どもにもあたる
dialogue.content: She also takes it out on our child.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 子どもの文句をいう
dialogue.content: She complains about our child.

dialogue.origin: たくさんありすぎて…
dialogue.content: There are just so many things…

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 何について怒ってるんですか？お子さんのことですか？
dialogue.content: What is she getting angry about? Is it about your child?

dialogue.origin: 子どものことで怒ることもあれば、ちょっとしたことで怒ったりしてます
dialogue.content: Sometimes she gets angry about the child, and other times it's over small things.

dialogue.origin: ドアがしまってないとか靴がひっくりかえってるとか
dialogue.content: Like the door not being closed or shoes being upside down.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、生活上のことですか
dialogue.content: I see, so things related to daily life.

dialogue.origin: お子さんの事は、どんな内容で怒ってますか？
dialogue.content: Regarding your child, what kinds of things does she get angry about?

dialogue.origin: ほとんどがそうですね。妻は家にいるので。
dialogue.content: Most of it is, yes. Since my wife is at home.

dialogue.origin: 子どもはちょっとのんびり屋さんなんです
dialogue.content: Our child is a bit laid-back.

dialogue.origin: 妻の思う存分ペースでできないとイライラしてしまったり
dialogue.content: She gets irritated when he can't do things at the pace she wants.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、ほとんどがお子さんの事で怒ってるんですね
dialogue.content: I see, so she's mostly angry about your child.

dialogue.origin: そののんびりは私のせいとか言われたり
dialogue.content: She even says that the child’s laid-back nature is my fault.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、のんびり屋さんなんですね
dialogue.content: I see—so your child is easygoing.

dialogue.origin: ほとんどではないですが、子どものことでも怒っています
dialogue.content: It’s not most of it, but she does get angry about the child as well.

dialogue.origin: そこが奥様には気になるところなんですね
dialogue.content: That seems to be what bothers your wife.

dialogue.origin: 良くいえばのんびり、ちょっと不器用なんです
dialogue.content: To put it positively, they’re laid-back; they’re also a bit clumsy.

dialogue.origin: まだ小さいので気にしても仕方ないしその子の個性だと思うんですけどね
dialogue.content: They’re still little, so I think there’s no use worrying—it’s just their personality.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、どんなところが不器用なんですか？
dialogue.content: I see. In what ways are they clumsy?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、個性って大切ですよね
dialogue.content: You're right, individuality is important.

dialogue.origin: お箸がじょうずにもてなかったり、折り紙とか折るのがうまくなかったり
dialogue.content: They don’t hold chopsticks well, and they’re not good at things like folding origami.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ご飯もゆっくり時間をかけて食べていたりですね
dialogue.content: They also eat their meals slowly, taking their time.

dialogue.origin: よく、こぼしていたりします
dialogue.content: They often spill things.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、奥様は気になっちゃうわけですね
dialogue.content: I see... and that gets on your wife's nerves.

dialogue.origin: 子どもなのでそんなことは当たり前というか…
dialogue.content: But for a child, that’s to be expected…

dialogue.origin: 機嫌のいいときはそんなに気にならないようです
dialogue.content: When she’s in a good mood, it doesn’t seem to bother her as much.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、機嫌がいい時ってどんな感じですか？
dialogue.content: I see. What is she like when she’s in a good mood?

dialogue.origin: 今いったことがほとんどないです
dialogue.content: Most of what I just mentioned doesn’t happen.

dialogue.origin: 怒ることもあまりないし、無視されないし
dialogue.content: She rarely gets angry and doesn’t ignore us.

dialogue.origin: 穏やかにすごしていますよ
dialogue.content: We spend our time peacefully.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そうしますと、お子さんがこぼしたりして機嫌悪くなのではなく、機嫌悪い時にこぼしたりすると怒られるってかんじですか？
dialogue.content: So it’s not that your child spilling something makes her get into a bad mood, but rather that if she’s already in a bad mood and the child spills something, she gets angry—is that right?

dialogue.origin: どちらかというとそんな感じです
dialogue.content: If I had to say, it's more like that.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、有難うございます
dialogue.content: I see. Thank you for clarifying.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: このことは、誰かに相談されたりしてますか？
dialogue.content: Have you spoken to anyone else about this?

dialogue.origin: してないです。
dialogue.content: No, I haven’t.

dialogue.origin: 妻の悪口みたいで、はなせないです
dialogue.content: It feels like I’m bad-mouthing my wife, so I can’t really talk about it.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね、気になっちゃいますよね。
dialogue.content: I understand; that would make you hesitant.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ３年以上も続いてて、なぜ今回ご相談されようと思われたんですか？
dialogue.content: This has been going on for over three years—what led you to seek counseling now?

dialogue.origin: 私がとてもつらいので…
dialogue.content: Because it has become very hard for me...

dialogue.origin: 前からつらかったですが、ふんぎりつかなくて
dialogue.content: It’s been hard for a long time, but I couldn’t bring myself to take action.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、ご相談いただき有難うございます。今回ふんぎりついた理由とかあったりしますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Thank you for coming to talk about it. Was there any particular reason you decided to take the step now?

dialogue.origin: 私がとてもつらいからです
dialogue.content: Because I’m really struggling.

dialogue.origin: はい、わかりました。いろいろお話頂き有難うございます。
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand. Thank you for sharing all of this with me.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: You're welcome.

dialogue.origin: ここまでのお話を少し纏めさせて頂いて宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: May I summarize what I’ve heard so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 奥様が機嫌悪いことが多く、それに気づかいで相談者様は大変疲れている
dialogue.content: Your wife is often in a bad mood, and you've become very tired from being so considerate of her.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 機嫌悪いと、八つ当たりしたり、お子さんに怒ったりしている
dialogue.content: When she's in a bad mood, she takes it out on you and gets angry with your child.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お子さんが生まれてから特にひどくなった
dialogue.content: It’s gotten particularly bad since your child was born.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: こんな状況で宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Does that sound about right?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it does.

dialogue.origin: ここで少し私が感じた事をお伝えさせて頂いても宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be okay if I shared some of my thoughts on this?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様はこれまでの奥様の対応で大変疲れてらっしゃいます
dialogue.content: You are very exhausted from dealing with your wife's behavior up to this point.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ちょっとした事で怒るみたいですが、怒ってる内容は、無理なことではなく、できて当たり前の事が多いように感じます
dialogue.content: It sounds like she gets angry over small things, but the things she gets angry about don't seem unreasonable, but rather things that are expected.

dialogue.origin: でもお子さんはまだ３歳で、今いろいろ覚えてる最中でもあります。
dialogue.content: But your child is still three years old and in the midst of learning many things.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 奥様は非常にキッチリしてる方とお見受けします。
dialogue.content: Your wife strikes me as a very meticulous person.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でもお子さんは３歳で、人格形成に非常に大切な時期かと思います
dialogue.content: But your child is three, which I believe is a very important time for personality development.

dialogue.origin: 奥様が機嫌悪くなるのには、なんらかの理由が存在すると思われます
dialogue.content: There is likely some reason behind your wife’s bad moods.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: お子さんの成長のためにも、ご家庭円満のためにも、
dialogue.content: For the sake of your child's development, and for the peace of your family,

dialogue.origin: 一度じっくり奥様と話あわれてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: perhaps you could try having a thorough discussion with your wife?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: わかりました。全く話してないわけではないんです。
dialogue.content: I understand. It’s not that we haven’t talked at all.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: でも、もっと話したほうがいいですよね
dialogue.content: But we should probably talk more, right?

dialogue.origin: お子さまの成長に影響がありますので、その辺で奥様と話あわれたらと思います
dialogue.content: It will affect your child's development, so I think it would be good to talk with your wife about that.

dialogue.origin: 子どもの成長のことについて話せばいいんですね。
dialogue.content: So I should talk to her about our child's development.

dialogue.origin: お子さんの人格形成とか気になりますよね。怒って育てるより、褒めて育てる事にどうお考えか、気になります
dialogue.content: You're concerned about your child's personality development, right? I'm curious how she feels about raising a child with praise versus anger.

dialogue.origin: ぜひ、ご機嫌いい時にでも話あわれてみてください。
dialogue.content: Please try to bring it up when she’s in a good mood.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。子どものことですね
dialogue.content: I see—focus on our child, then.

dialogue.origin: わかりました。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今日のご相談は他には大丈夫でしたでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else you would like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: とりあえず話してみます。ただ、私のつらいのは子どものこと話せばよくなるのか心配です
dialogue.content: I’ll try talking with her for now. I’m just worried whether talking about our child will really help with how hard this is for me.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、育児上での気づきから、相談者様への八つ当たりとかも改善されればと思いましたが
dialogue.content: I see. I was hoping that some insights regarding child-rearing might also lead to an improvement in how she takes things out on you.

dialogue.origin: 育児のお話と、なぜ機嫌悪くなのか、八つ当たりとか、育児上よくないこととか、
dialogue.content: So, discussing parenting, why she gets in bad moods, the lashing out, and parenting practices that may not be ideal…

dialogue.origin: 奥様とじっくり話されることをお勧めします
dialogue.content: I recommend having a thorough conversation with your wife.

dialogue.origin: わかりました。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 有難うございました。
dialogue.content: You're welcome.

dialogue.origin: 今日のご相談はこれにて終了で宜しかったでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Shall we conclude today’s session here?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 有難うございました。お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much. I appreciate your time today.

dialogue.origin: お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。とても勉強になりました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. This was very helpful.
